When: Every October weekend: Saturdays & Sundays! Where: 5703 208th Ave NE, Redmond, WA 98053 Duration: 3 Hours | Last entry at 3:00 PM (activities end at 4 PM) Ticket Pricing Adults: $12 Children (Ages 1–17): $20 (includes 1 feed bag to feed the animals!) posts.title: Storywalk at Alderwood Park: César’s Cerulean Surprise
posts.headline: Tacoma · 星期六亲子精选
highlights: 边走边读故事步道上的《César’s Cerulean Surprise》，用是非提问一起探索cerulean是什么颜色，真实呈现兄妹互动。文中穿插西语词汇与数学小线索，作者附注还为家长提供互动建议，助力在阅读中建立数学连接。
posts.description: Walk along and read the Storywalk at Alderwood Park during the park’s open hours. The September/October title is César’s Cerulean Surprise by Jenny Lacika. César asks to borrow his sister Gabi’s cerulean crayon, but Gabi does not know what cerulean is and decides to identify the color by asking yes-no questions. It’s a window into an all-too-familiar sibling dynamic, a slice of life many readers can identify with. Along with the subtle math hints, both Gabi and César sprinkle in Spanish words. Further explanation can be found in an author’s note, along with interactive tips for adults, showing how to encourage the math connections during reading.

highlights: 曾被 Reader’s Digest 评为华州最佳南瓜园，亲子友好、传统满满。多主题玉米迷宫、奶牛小火车、拖拉车观光、苹果炮、跳跳垫和农场动物，玩上好几个小时。还有集市小吃、咖啡和甜甜圈，边玩边吃更尽兴。
posts.description: Named Washington State’s best pumpkin patch by “Readers Digest” in 2019, and more recently among the best pumpkin farms in the country (!), this farm is justifiably very popular, especially with younger kids. As the Snohomish Valley’s Original Pumpkin Patch, Craven Farm is a decades old tradition for many families. Continue your family tradition or start a new one this fall at Craven Farm! At Craven Farm, we’re dedicated to creating an enjoyable and memorable fall experience for everyone who visits us. Our farm offers an extensive range of activities to suit all age groups, including apple cannons and slingers, fair foods, espresso, and donuts. Our unique attractions like cow trains, wagon rides, multiple acres of themed corn mazes, jump pad & animals are sure to keep you entertained for hours on end. Visit us today and make some unforgettable memories with us this fall! Check out our huge list of pumpkin extravaganzas happening this year.

roundup.caption:
这个周末，6 个城市都有适合家庭的活动！🌿

本周亮点包括「Rainier Valley Co-op Preschool Fall Festival and Open House」和「Spooky Science at the Burke Museum」，适合安排轻松又充实的亲子时光。从户外探索到社区活动，各个城市都有值得带孩子一起体验的选择。

我们整理了 8 场地区亮点：

1. Seattle：Rainier Valley Co-op Preschool Fall Festival and Open House
   地点：Rainier Valley Cooperative Preschool · 5514 15th Ave S, Seattle, WA, 98108, United States
   趋势关键词：fall festival
   亮点：Jon Pontrello 带来亲子现场，滑棒吉他、班卓琴、卡祖笛和勺子打击乐热闹开唱。

   亮点：在生物体验展区拼拼动物身体部位、做只小蝙蝠带回家，还能在玩偶上体验标本准备。

3. Bellevue：Red Barn Farm Fall Festival

posts.title: Rainier Valley Co-op Preschool Fall Festival and Open House
posts.venueAddress: 5514 15th Ave S, Seattle, WA, 98108, United States
highlights: Jon Pontrello 带来亲子现场，滑棒吉他、班卓琴、卡祖笛和勺子打击乐热闹开唱。现压苹果汁、南瓜彩绘、学龄前友好小食和小型农夫市集齐聚。还有服装与冬季装备旧物义卖，欢迎现有、校友及想了解合作式幼儿园的家庭装扮来玩。

posts.title: Spooky Science at the Burke Museum
posts.venueAddress: 4303 Memorial Way NE, Seattle, WA, 98195, United States
highlights: 在生物体验展区拼拼动物身体部位、做只小蝙蝠带回家，还能在玩偶上体验标本准备。再到古生物体验展区，近距离认识史前可怖生物，解密会发幽光的矿物与华盛顿洞穴的地质奥秘。

posts.title: Red Barn Farm Fall Festival
posts.venueAddress: 5703 208th Ave NE, Redmond, WA, 98053, United States
